title: The Ancient Thorn
description: Sylas has found the source of the rot in the southern thicket: Elderthorn the Ancient, woken and vast, the sickness given a will and a reach. No single blade fells it. Gather a party, cut it down, and take clean blossoms from its heart — the physicians say the oldest growth holds the truest cure.
location_hint: Southern thicket, south-west of the village (-50, -45).

objectives.desc: Fell Elderthorn the Ancient with a party
Cut clean blossoms from its heart
